lessons.title: Boss: The Class Fund Puzzle
lessons.goal: 整合收據、現金紀錄與對話，找出合理解釋。
lessons.story:
[Class fund record]
The class starts with $600 for its garden project. On Monday, Nina buys seeds for $180 and labels for $60. She keeps both receipts. On Tuesday, she counts $340 in the money box, but her notebook says $360 should remain.

[Messages]
Nina: We are $20 short. Did anyone borrow money?
Jay: I bought string yesterday. It cost $20. I left the receipt under the notebook, but I forgot to write it down.
Nina: I can see it now. Next time, please record the purchase immediately.
Jay: I will. Should I put another $20 in the box?
Nina: No. The string was for our project. We need to update the record, not collect the money twice.

[New rule]
Before putting a receipt in the folder, the buyer must enter the date, item, and amount in the notebook. Another student checks the entry against the receipt.

words.example: Keep the receipt after buying seeds.
Record each purchase in the notebook.
Check the entry against the receipt.

questions.prompt: How much does the class have at the beginning?
questions.evidence: The class starts with $600 for its garden project.
reasons: 三百六十是未記繩子時的帳面餘額。
二百四十是種子加標籤花費。

options: Under the notebook.
At Jay’s home.
On the classroom wall.
Inside a seed bag.
questions.explanation: Jay 表示放在筆記本下面。
questions.evidence: I left the receipt under the notebook, but I forgot to write it down.
reasons: 精確對應 under the notebook。

questions.prompt: How much did Nina spend on seeds and labels?
questions.explanation: 種子一百八十加標籤六十，共二百四十元。
questions.evidence: On Monday, Nina buys seeds for $180 and labels for $60.
reasons: 多算 Jay 的繩子，不是題目問的兩項。

questions.prompt: Why does Nina say Jay should not add $20?
options: The string was a project expense that needs to be recorded.
Jay already put $20 back in the box.
The class received the string for free.
The garden project has been canceled.
questions.explanation: Nina 接受繩子是專案用途，所需是補登支出，不是再向 Jay 收錢。
questions.evidence: No. The string was for our project. We need to update the record, not collect the money twice.
reasons: Nina 的回覆把它當作專案支出。
Jay 只提出詢問，尚未放回。

questions.prompt: What must the buyer do before filing a receipt?
options: Throw away the old notebook.
Record the date, item, and amount.
Wait until the end of the project.
Ask every student for more money.
questions.explanation: 新規定要求收據歸檔前先登記三項資訊。
questions.evidence: Before putting a receipt in the folder, the buyer must enter the date, item, and amount in the notebook.

questions.prompt: What caused the class fund puzzle?
options: A real expense was missing from the written record.
Nina bought the same seeds twice.
Jay returned more money than he borrowed.
The class started without any money.
questions.explanation: 現金少二十元的原因是繩子已買但未登帳，不是錢被偷。
questions.evidence: It cost $20. I left the receipt under the notebook, but I forgot to write it down.
reasons: 已支出、未記錄兩者造成差異。

questions.prompt: What does “entry” mean in the new rule?
options: A written record of a purchase.
The amount collected next year.
The door to the garden.
A student entering a race.
questions.explanation: 比對收據與 entry，指剛寫入的帳目。
questions.evidence: Another student checks the entry against the receipt.
reasons: 對應帳本的一筆購買紀錄。

questions.prompt: What should the corrected remaining balance be?
questions.explanation: 六百減一百八十、六十與二十，剩三百四十，吻合現金。
questions.evidence: On Tuesday, she counts $340 in the money box, but her notebook says $360 should remain.

questions.prompt: Why does the new rule include a second student?
options: To compare the written amount with independent evidence.
To stop students from buying any supplies.
To replace all receipts with memories.
To make every purchase twice as expensive.
questions.explanation: 第二人用收據查帳，能發現漏登或抄錯，而不是單靠買的人回想。
questions.evidence: Another student checks the entry against the receipt.
reasons: 規定允許買東西但要記錄。
雙人檢查不會使價格翻倍。
